title.narrative: Rehabilitation project of intensive care, emergency and operating rooms in 5 hospitals in eastern Sudan

description.narrative: Providing life-saving medical equipment in various emergency departments, operations and intensive care units such as anesthesia machines, operating beds, emergency devices, ventilators, automatic injections, vital signs monitoring devices and intensive care beds in three states in eastern Sudan: Kassala, Gedaref and Port Sudan, and 5 hospitals, etc., in addition to maintaining these departments, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

The project aims to provide intensive care, emergency and surgical services in the eastern states of Sudan, Kassala, Gedaref, Port Sudan and the 5 most crowded central hospitals due to the increasing number of displaced persons due to the armed conflict in Sudan in addition to the local population. The weak government funding has made health facilities suffer from a significant weakness in infrastructure and most intensive care departments are out of service due to the lack of maintenance and weak government funding. The project is one of the most important projects due to its effective role in reducing citizen deaths in these states by providing life-saving medical devices in emergency departments and various intensive care operations such as anesthesia devices, operating beds, emergency devices, artificial respirators, automatic injections, vital signs monitoring devices, intensive care beds, etc. in addition to maintaining these departments, which will provide a distinguished and important health service with high quality.

This project will effectively contribute to alleviating the impact of war on Sudanese citizens affected by the war by providing intensive care services that Sudanese citizens struggle to provide, as well as increasing the capacity of surgical departments by providing basic equipment for operating and emergency departments.
